title: Bluedevil should have an option to compress files before sending
line: The Bluetooth send-file window has a "Compress files into a ZIP archive" checkbox that sends all chosen files as one ZIP.
explanation: bluedevil-sendfile always sent each selected file on its own, so the phone got one incoming file per item and there was no way to bundle them, as GNOME's sender can. The change adds a "Compress files into a ZIP archive" checkbox to every file/device selection page of the wizard (the device list used by Dolphin's Send via Bluetooth, the file picker opened from the Bluetooth applet, and the combined page). When it is checked, the wizard packs the files with KZip into a temporary folder (named after the file, or after the folder for several files, as Ark does), sends that single archive, and deletes it when the transfer ends; if compression fails, the wizard's error page says why and nothing is sent.

commits.message:
sendfile: add an option to compress the files into a ZIP archive

Sending several files to a phone arrives as many separate files, which
some phones can't save together. The wizard now has a checkbox that
packs the selected files into one ZIP archive and sends that instead.

BUG: 223602

media.caption: Send via Bluetooth with four files selected: only a device list, no way to bundle them
Same window with the new "Compress files into a ZIP archive" checkbox, ticked

With the option: one Holiday.zip holding the four files
Send File from the Bluetooth applet (device already chosen): file picker with no option
The same picker shows the checkbox under File type; notes.txt arrived as notes.zip (43 KB instead of 106 KB)
